title: Ising Expectations and Social Interactions
research_question: Do peer interactions produce belief coordination and new nonlinear policy responses beyond ordinary heterogeneous expectations?
mechanisms: Probabilistic belief transitions and macro feedback
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Specify precisely what is forecast and how information and beliefs enter choices.
An Ising fixed point is not automatically a rational-expectations general equilibrium.
Restore the Stage 0 rational-expectations rule in a matched no-social-interaction benchmark.
acceptance_tests: Fixed-point stability and multiplicity under stated parameter normalization
Household feasibility and general equilibrium residuals

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
